# New renderings and departures, iliad-047 (8.97–197)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| καί μιν φωνήσας ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα (8.101; departure from 1.201) | "and, lifting his voice, to him winged words he spoke:" | "and lifting his voice he spoke winged words to him:" | "to her" (the published English of 1.201, where μιν is Athena; here μιν is Nestor). The line sits inside a longer unit (8.99–101), so the validator's whole-unit rule does not apply. |
| ἀμήχανα ἔργα (8.130) | "deeds past help" | "deeds past all remedy" | "helpless deeds" (the Odyssey table's ἀμήχανος "helpless" is for persons and reads wrongly of deeds), "impossible deeds", "dreadful deeds"; ἀμήχανος is "without resource" (μηχανή) |
| ἀσπιστάων (Τρώων … ἀσπιστάων, 8.155) | "shield-bearers" | "shield-bearers" | "spearmen" (reserved for αἰχμητής), "warriors", "shield-men"; ἀσπιστής is "one who carries a shield" |
| βέλεα στονόεντα (8.159; departure from the Odyssey's "arrows full of groaning", 24.180) | "missiles full of groaning" | "missiles that brought groaning" | "arrows" (the Odyssey's rendering; here the poet does not say which weapons the Trojans pour), "darts"; βέλος is "missile" in `l` throughout |
| γλήνη (κακὴ γλήνη, 8.164) | "base doll" | "worthless doll" | "puppet", "pupil", "girl-baby"; γλήνη is both "doll" and "pupil of the eye", and the note gives "doll" only |
| δαίμονα δώσω (8.166) | "your destiny I shall give" | "I shall deal you your destiny" | "fate" (reserved for μοῖρα, πότμος, μόρος), "doom", "your god"; δαίμων is a divine power, here the one that deals out a man's lot |
| δαιδάλεος (θώρηκα, 8.195) | "cunningly wrought" | "cunningly wrought" | "richly wrought" (kept for πολυδαίδαλος), "intricate" (reserved for ποικίλος), "ornate" |
| ὑπερώησαν (8.122) | "swerved aside" | "swerved aside" | "shied" (modern), "reared", "bolted"; rare verb, "swerve" the usual explanation |
| ἠπεδανός (8.104) | "weak" | "feeble" | "lame", "decrepit"; rare word, usually explained "infirm" |
| σημάντωρ (8.127) | "commander" | "someone to command them" | "master", "guide", "driver" (the driver is ἡνίοχος) |
| κομιδή (8.186) | "the tending" | "the care" | "keep", "nursing"; κομέω is "tend" (113, 109) |
| Horses' names (8.185) | Xanthus, Podargus, Aethon, Lampus | same | "Chestnut", "Blaze" and the like (a note gives the meanings) |
